title: grover-v1 timed cases, Italian and English
goal: The model's use of the duration is measured
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "yes to both", including a timed switch in Grover ("spegni il ventilatore per 2 ore") via MCP behind NERV's approval. Italian is required for every model-facing feature.

"spegni il ventilatore per 2 ore" → grover_switch {on: false, durationMinutes: 120} proposed for approval; "turn the light on for 30 minutes" → durationMinutes 30; a duration over the maximum or an unclear one ("per un po'") is asked back, never invented; a pump with a duration refused; regression and holdout splits
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: about 5 cases added to the F-027 pack. Not a measurement.
